summary: Diff adds three new files for eval-2-oncall-plan-redteam (with_skill run). grading.json scores a red-team review of a US-East/Krakow on-call rotation plan: all 9 expectations pass, covering severity ranking, failure scenarios, the timezone coverage gap, Krakow readiness risk, the US-only IC pool undermining the zero-overnight-pages goal, a verdict of structural failure, DST/handover/rollback coverage, per-finding retest checks, and a minimum-changes list. It also records execution metrics, timing, five re-derived claims (two unverified), workarounds, and eval feedback flagging that process/corroboration claims can't be checked without a transcript. charter.md is the red-team charter (artifact, harm categories, out-of-scope, success criterion) for that review. metrics.json duplicates the tool-call/step counts.

claims.text: grading.json summary reports 9 passed, 0 failed, 9 total, pass_rate 1.0
Winter coverage gap is 01:00-07:00 UTC (20:00-02:00 ET), 6 hours, with a 13:00-19:00 UTC overlap between shifts
DST mismatch weeks shrink the US/Krakow offset to 5h and grow the coverage gap to 7 hours
F1 and F2 were found independently by all three adversaries, F4 by two, and twelve adversary findings merged into seven with none killed
Report claims Polish statutory leave minimum 'exceeds 20 days'
Timezone/DST arithmetic was independently re-derived during Stage 3 verification and held
Write tool rejected report.md, so report was written via shell heredoc with identical content
Executor's tool calls: Read 2, Write 2, Agent 3, Bash 1, totaling 8 tool calls over 5 steps
metrics.json independently lists the same tool_calls (Read 2, Write 2, Agent 3, Bash 1), 8 total, 5 steps, and files_created list
Charter scopes review to whether the on-call plan actually achieves coverage, cost, risk, and maintainability, excluding hiring/org/tooling decisions

risks.note: Corroboration counts ('found independently by all three adversaries', 'twelve merged into seven, none killed') are marked verified:false in the source because no transcript exists to check them — the report narrates process claims that can't be audited from outputs alone.
Report states Polish statutory leave 'exceeds 20 days' but the grading entry notes actual minimum is exactly 20 (26 with 10+ years); flagged as imprecise though not load-bearing.

least_confident: Whether the underlying report.md findings themselves (not shown in this chunk) actually contain the wording the grading.json evidence quotes, since this chunk only shows the grading/metrics/charter files, not the report content being graded.
